relationships.subject: NAcc GABAergic neurons
relationships.evidence_quote: Microdialysis coupled with liquid chromatography/tandem mass spectrometry analysis revealed significant alterations in extracellular concentration levels of GABA, glutamate, acetylcholine, dopamine, and citrulline in NAcc upon optic stimulation.

key_findings: Optogenetic stimulation of NAcc GABAergic neurons reduces tonic and burst firing of VPM thalamic neurons and improves pain behaviors in infraorbital nerve-constricted rats.
NAcc stimulation increases extracellular GABA, glutamate, dopamine and acetylcholine and decreases citrulline in the NAcc of TN rats.
